title: Stories of Care and Recovery
subtitle: Hear from our patients as they share their journeys of recovery, care, and renewed independence.

items.name: Mohamed Al Menhali
items.quote: Alhamdulillah, I regained my ability to walk in about 4 months with their help.

items.name: Mohamed Salem Al Bloushi
items.quote: Thank God, I was able to get back to walking within a timeframe of almost 4 months with God’s will and the help of the team.

items.name: Tamam’s Mother
items.quote: We are truly grateful for the significant improvements we have observed in Tamam’s communication abilities.

items.name: Shamma’s Mother
items.quote: Shamma’s ability to communicate has improved remarkably and significantly, thanks to Cambridge.

items.name: Salem Bin Saleh
items.quote: Thank God, I was able to get back to walking within a timeframe of almost 4 months with God’s will and the help of the team.

items.name: Nujood Saeed
items.quote: With God’s grace and the team’s support, I was walking again in nearly 4 months.
